title: Track, check the alternate hub, then reroute with approval
prompt: TG-604227 has been stuck at Holmquay. Please check where it is, see whether its alternate hub can take it, and reroute it if possible.
rubric: Calls track, then hub_capacity on the alternate hub TRB, then reroute (approved by a human), and reports the new ETA from the reroute result without inventing anything.

title: Track, capacity, reroute, then ETA confidence
prompt: Track TG-604118, check whether its alternate hub can take it, reroute it, and then give me the ETA confidence.
rubric: Runs four tools one at a time in order, with the reroute approved, and reports the rerouted hub, the new window from the reroute and the confidence from the ETA record.

title: Reroute of a held shipment is denied by the approver
prompt: TG-604305 is held at Wyncliff. Move it to its alternate hub if you can.
rubric: Checks the alternate hub, requests the reroute, and when the human denies it says plainly that the shipment stays held and nothing was changed.

title: Reroute of an in-transit shipment is denied
prompt: TG-604412 needs to reach Pellam sooner. Move it to its alternate hub if you can.
rubric: Follows the track, capacity, reroute order, and after the denial states that the shipment keeps its current route and nothing was changed.

title: No reroute when the alternate hub is closed
prompt: TG-604677 is delayed. Can you reroute it through its alternate hub?
rubric: Finds the alternate hub WYN, sees it is closed, does not call reroute, explains why and offers to check the ETA instead.

title: Explain a berth queue delay with track then eta
prompt: Why is TG-604227 late and when will it arrive?
rubric: Reports the delay at HLM, the ETA window and the low confidence, and says the window may move.

title: Explain a cancelled linehaul with track then eta
prompt: Where is TG-604677 and when will it be delivered?
rubric: States the shipment is delayed at KRN after a cancelled linehaul and quotes the ETA window with medium confidence and the driver shortage reason.

title: Track then eta for a shipment on time
prompt: Track TG-604733 and give me its ETA.
rubric: Gives the status and last event from track and the ETA window and confidence from eta, with no delay reason.

title: Check an open alternate hub
prompt: Is the alternate hub for TG-604118 open?
rubric: Looks up the alternate hub from track, then reports MAV status, utilisation, reroute acceptance and cutoff, without rerouting.

title: Check capacity at another alternate hub
prompt: What's the capacity at the alternate hub for TG-604412?
rubric: Finds KRN as the alternate hub and reports its status, utilisation, reroute acceptance and cutoff.

title: Track a delivered shipment
prompt: Has TG-604590 been delivered?
rubric: Confirms delivery with the date and time of the signature and does not offer a reroute.

title: Look up an ETA
prompt: What is the ETA for TG-604118?
rubric: Quotes the ETA window and the high confidence exactly as the eta tool returned them.

title: Look up one hub
prompt: How busy is the Orsley Park hub today?
rubric: Reports ORS status, utilisation, reroute acceptance and cutoff from the hub_capacity result.

title: Unknown shipment id
prompt: Where is TG-999999?
rubric: Says the id is not on file, suggests checking the booking confirmation and does not guess another id.

title: Read the delay_handling skill then track and eta
prompt: TG-604305 is stuck. Explain what happened and when it should arrive.
rubric: Reads the delay_handling skill first, then calls track and eta and explains the yard closure, the ETA window and the low confidence.

title: Read the rerouting skill and stop at a congested hub
prompt: Can you move TG-604733 to its alternate hub?
rubric: Reads the rerouting skill, finds the alternate hub HLM congested and not accepting reroutes, and does not call reroute.

title: When a late shipment is escalated
prompt: When does a late shipment get escalated?
rubric: Says a shipment more than 24 hours late goes to the account manager and the shipper is told within 2 hours, citing the delay escalation SOP.

title: Cargo claim window
prompt: How long do I have to lodge a cargo claim?
rubric: States the 21 day window from delivery, or from the expected delivery date for lost goods, citing the cargo claims procedure.

title: Liability per kilogram on CC-22
prompt: What is the liability per kilogram on contract CC-22?
rubric: Gives 12.00 per kilogram based on gross weight on the delivery note, citing the CC-22 contract summary.

title: Daily cutoff at a hub
prompt: What is the daily cutoff at the Tarnwick Gate depot?
rubric: Gives the 19:00 cutoff for TRB and says later arrivals are sorted the next day, citing the hub directory.

title: Dangerous goods that are refused
prompt: Which dangerous goods do you refuse outright?
rubric: Lists class 1 explosives, class 6.2 infectious substances and class 7 radioactive material as always refused, citing the dangerous goods policy.

title: Maximum pallet height
prompt: What is the maximum pallet height?
rubric: States the 1.8 metre limit including the pallet and load and that taller pallets are declined at pickup, citing the packaging standards.

title: Peak season surcharge
prompt: How much is the peak season surcharge and when does it apply?
rubric: Gives 4.5 percent of the freight charge for pickups from 2026-11-16 to 2026-12-24, citing the surcharge notice.

title: Hubs on Christmas Day
prompt: Are the hubs open on Christmas Day?
rubric: Says all six hubs are closed on 2026-12-25 while the operations desk keeps running, citing the holiday operating schedule.
